dialogues.jp: 訓練を始めてから、１週間くらい経った日の事。
dialogues.en: We arrive at my school.
dialogues.text: We arrive at my school.

dialogues.jp: （何だか、調子いいみたいだな）

これまでの頼子さんは背中を丸めたりしていて
どうにも頼りない風だったのに、今夜は違う。
dialogues.en:
She doesn't stop walking. She passes the school gate and
she's still walking forward.
dialogues.text:
She doesn't stop walking. She passes the school gate and
she's still walking forward.

dialogues.jp:
ぴしゃんと伸びた背筋。まっすぐ前を向いた頭。
規則正しく振られる、左右の手。それに振り返っ
て俺が居るかどうかを確認したりもしない。
dialogues.en: (She may be able to go all the way to our goal......)
dialogues.text: (She may be able to go all the way to our goal......)

dialogues.jp: （う〜ん、いいぞ）
dialogues.en: I hurry up my steps as well.
dialogues.text: I hurry up my steps as well.

dialogues.jp:
背中に自信が見て取れるというか。頼子さんは
軽快に歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
(But I've been thinking for a while, I look just like a
stalker......)
dialogues.text:
(But I've been thinking for a while, I look just like a
stalker......)

dialogues.jp: 学園前までやって来た。

dialogues.en: "Oh, we're here!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, we're here!"

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんの歩みは、｛とどこお／滞｝らない。門の前を通り過
ぎ、さらに向こうへと歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
I taste a victory that's probably like those tasted by
Columbus and other explorers.
dialogues.text:
I taste a victory that's probably like those tasted by
Columbus and other explorers.

dialogues.jp: （こりゃ、ゴール出来るかも……）
dialogues.en: I run to her as she finally stops and takes a deep breath.
dialogues.text: I run to her as she finally stops and takes a deep breath.

dialogues.jp: 遅れじと、俺も歩を急ぐ。
dialogues.en: "I walked all the way......"
dialogues.text: "I walked all the way......"

dialogues.jp: そして……。
dialogues.en: "Yes! I knew you could do it."
dialogues.text: "Yes! I knew you could do it."

dialogues.jp: 「おおっ、着いたっ」
dialogues.en: I hold both of her hands and shake them up and down.
dialogues.text: I hold both of her hands and shake them up and down.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「着けました……」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... you're gonna make me fall over......"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... you're gonna make me fall over......"

dialogues.jp: 両手をがっしり握り、上下にぶんぶん振り回す。
dialogues.en: "It's okay! I'll catch you!"
dialogues.text: "It's okay! I'll catch you!"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あうぅ……こ、転んでしまいます……」
くるくると目を回している。
dialogues.en:
Her eyes start to roll in circles. I'm so happy that if I
was strong enough, I could have lifted her up in my arms and
spun around in a circle.
dialogues.text:
Her eyes start to roll in circles. I'm so happy that if I
was strong enough, I could have lifted her up in my arms and
spun around in a circle.

dialogues.jp:
俺にもうちっとパワーがあれば、抱きかかえて
くるくる回転したいくらいだった。
dialogues.en: But unfortunately there's no way I could do that.
dialogues.text: But unfortunately there's no way I could do that.

dialogues.jp: 無理だけど。
dialogues.en: "You did great. I'm so happy for you."
dialogues.text: "You did great. I'm so happy for you."

dialogues.jp:
「でも、良く頑張ったねえ。おりゃ、ほんと嬉
　しいよ」
dialogues.en:
She's about to fall over for real, so I let her hands go.
We're both breathing heavily.
dialogues.text:
She's about to fall over for real, so I let her hands go.
We're both breathing heavily.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉さんの……おかげです」
dialogues.en: "......It's because of you, Junichi-san."
dialogues.text: "......It's because of you, Junichi-san."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや。そんな、ご謙遜を」
dialogues.en: "No, no, no. Don't humble yourself."
dialogues.text: "No, no, no. Don't humble yourself."

dialogues.jp: 冗談めかして首を振るが、言葉は本当だ。
dialogues.en: I'm smiling, but I'm not joking about that.
dialogues.text: I'm smiling, but I'm not joking about that.

dialogues.jp:
「頼子さんの努力だよ。それがあったから文字
　通り──」
dialogues.en:
"You did it. Because you tried so hard, you
completely......"
dialogues.text:
"You did it. Because you tried so hard, you
completely......"

dialogues.jp: 背後を振り返って、
dialogues.en: I look back and see the road we walked.
dialogues.text: I look back and see the road we walked.

dialogues.jp: 「道を切り開けたんだ」
dialogues.en: "You carved out a path."
dialogues.text: "You carved out a path."

dialogues.jp: と、ポエマーな俺は話を結んだ。
dialogues.en: I tell her like I was reading a poem.
dialogues.text: I tell her like I was reading a poem.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……今の台詞、そんなにクサかったかな？」
dialogues.en: "O-kay. I did sound old-fashioned, didn't I?"
dialogues.text: "O-kay. I did sound old-fashioned, didn't I?"

dialogues.jp:
驚きの表情に出迎えられて、さすがに照れる。
ガラじゃなかったか？
dialogues.en:
She still looks surprised, and I'm embarrassed. I shouldn't
have tried to sound cool......
dialogues.text:
She still looks surprised, and I'm embarrassed. I shouldn't
have tried to sound cool......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私が……道を切り開く……」
dialogues.en: "I...... carved out a path......"
dialogues.text: "I...... carved out a path......"

dialogues.jp:
視線がくるっと裏返ったような、そんな奇妙な
印象を受けた。
dialogues.en:
I feel very weird when I see her eyes. They look like they
just flipped inside...
dialogues.text:
I feel very weird when I see her eyes. They look like they
just flipped inside...

dialogues.jp:
内部に──心の内へと、その目が向けられてい
るような。
dialogues.en: To see the inner side of her heart.
dialogues.text: To see the inner side of her heart.

dialogues.jp: 「頼子……さん？」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko......san?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko......san?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉さん……」
dialogues.en: "......Junichi-san......"
dialogues.text: "......Junichi-san......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「訓練は、まだ終わっていませんよ」
dialogues.en: "My training hasn't finished yet."
dialogues.text: "My training hasn't finished yet."

dialogues.jp: 例の寂しげな笑顔だった。
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
言葉よりも、むしろ表情に気を取られ、俺はお
うむ返しに繰り返していた。
dialogues.en:
There's the sad smile on her face again. I'm caught by the
expression on her face more than the words she says, and I
repeat the words like a parrot.
dialogues.text:
There's the sad smile on her face again. I'm caught by the
expression on her face more than the words she says, and I
repeat the words like a parrot.

dialogues.jp: 「終わっていない？」
dialogues.en: "Your training hasn't finished yet?"
dialogues.text: "Your training hasn't finished yet?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ベンチに座って……一人で……」
dialogues.en: "I have to...... sit on the bench alone......"
dialogues.text: "I have to...... sit on the bench alone......"

dialogues.jp:
言って、ぽつねんと立っている無人のベンチに
目を向ける。
dialogues.en: She looks at the bench.
dialogues.text: She looks at the bench.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それが、残っています」
dialogues.en: "I still have to do it."
dialogues.text: "I still have to do it."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ……そっか」
dialogues.en: "Ah, y-yeah......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, y-yeah......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「座ってきますね。……見ていてくれますか？」
dialogues.en:
"I will go sit there...... Could you stay here and watch
me?"
dialogues.text:
"I will go sit there...... Could you stay here and watch
me?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、もちろん」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I could."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I could."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それでは、行ってきます」
dialogues.en: "Then, here I go."
dialogues.text: "Then, here I go."

dialogues.jp:
す、と手を挙げ、とてとてと駆けていく。俺は
警官のように敬礼した。
dialogues.en:
She slightly lifts her hand and walks to the bench. I stand
there, giving her a salute like a policeman.
dialogues.text:
She slightly lifts her hand and walks to the bench. I stand
there, giving her a salute like a policeman.

dialogues.jp: 寂しげな笑顔が目の前に浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: I think about her sad smile again.
dialogues.text: I think about her sad smile again.

dialogues.jp:
何であんな表情をしたんだ？　目標達成の現場
には、似つかわしくない顔だった。
dialogues.en:
Why did she look so sad? It wasn't a proper face to have
when she just accomplished her goal.
dialogues.text:
Why did she look so sad? It wasn't a proper face to have
when she just accomplished her goal.

dialogues.jp:
そう。目標を達成したのは事実。謙遜しようが
何をしようが、事実、彼女はやり遂げた。
dialogues.en:
That's right. She did achieve her goal. No matter how humble
she is, the face is that she did achieve her goal.
dialogues.text:
That's right. She did achieve her goal. No matter how humble
she is, the face is that she did achieve her goal.

dialogues.jp: という事は──。
dialogues.en: So that means...
dialogues.text: So that means...

dialogues.jp:
きっと、あの顔は、今のこの現場に向けられた
ものじゃなかった。
dialogues.en: She looked sad because of some other reason?
dialogues.text: She looked sad because of some other reason?

dialogues.jp: たぶん、｛いま／現在｝ではなくて、過去。
dialogues.en: Maybe it's something about her past.
dialogues.text: Maybe it's something about her past.

dialogues.jp:
何か、自分の努力で道を切り開けなかった過去
でもあったのだろうか……？
dialogues.en:
Was there a time in her past when she couldn't carve out a
path on her own?
dialogues.text:
Was there a time in her past when she couldn't carve out a
path on her own?

dialogues.jp: 「……猫なのに？　ふ〜む……」
dialogues.en: "......Even though she used to be a cat?"
dialogues.text: "......Even though she used to be a cat?"

dialogues.jp: 「……縄張り争い？」
dialogues.en: "......A turf battle, maybe?"
dialogues.text: "......A turf battle, maybe?"

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ１０分か、というところで、それは起
こった。
dialogues.en: It happens when about 10 minutes have passed.
dialogues.text: It happens when about 10 minutes have passed.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何だ、あいつ……」
dialogues.en: "What? Who's that......?"
dialogues.text: "What? Who's that......?"

dialogues.jp:
ベンチに座る頼子さんに、近づいていく人物が
居る。
dialogues.en:
There's a person walking toward Yoriko-san as she sits on
the bench.
dialogues.text:
There's a person walking toward Yoriko-san as she sits on
the bench.

dialogues.jp:
ナンパ野郎か？　と思いつつ、どう見ても野郎
には見えない。
dialogues.en:
Is he trying to hit on her? But the person doesn't look like
a dude...
dialogues.text:
Is he trying to hit on her? But the person doesn't look like
a dude...

dialogues.jp: というか、ありゃ、さくらだ。
dialogues.en: In fact, it's Sakura.
dialogues.text: In fact, it's Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
「……なんで、さくらがこんなところに？　頼
　子さんに何の用なんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"......But what's Sakura doing here? What does she want to
do with Yoriko-san?"
dialogues.text:
"......But what's Sakura doing here? What does she want to
do with Yoriko-san?"

dialogues.jp: 二人は知り合いなんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Do they know each other? Sakura's walking up to Yoriko-san
without hesitation. I can't see her expression from here.
dialogues.text:
Do they know each other? Sakura's walking up to Yoriko-san
without hesitation. I can't see her expression from here.

dialogues.jp:
ともかく、さくらは何の｛ちゅうちょ／躊躇｝もなく近づいてい
く。表情までは窺えない。
dialogues.en:
"Oh...... they're bowing to each other. So I guess they just
met each other for the first time."
dialogues.text:
"Oh...... they're bowing to each other. So I guess they just
met each other for the first time."

dialogues.jp:
「あ……二人して、ぺこぺこお辞儀しだした。
　初対面か」
dialogues.en:
It's a funny sight. They're bowing to each other like
they're toys on springs.
dialogues.text:
It's a funny sight. They're bowing to each other like
they're toys on springs.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっとした｛こっけい／滑稽｝さを覚える光景だった。バネ
仕掛けで動くおもちゃのように。
dialogues.en: Sakura sits down next to Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text: Sakura sits down next to Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、頼子さんの隣に腰かけた。そして、
そのままの姿勢が続く。
dialogues.en: "......What are they talking about?"
dialogues.text: "......What are they talking about?"

dialogues.jp: 「……何を話してるんだ？」
dialogues.en: I should have just gone out to them but I missed the timing.
dialogues.text: I should have just gone out to them but I missed the timing.

dialogues.jp:
さっさと出ていけばいいのだが、タイミングを
逸したようで、何となく腰が重い。
dialogues.en: "But...... I want to know."
dialogues.text: "But...... I want to know."

dialogues.jp: 「でも……気にはなるな」
dialogues.en:
The situation's even more curious if the two of them don't
know each other. What does Sakura want to do with
Yoriko-san?
dialogues.text:
The situation's even more curious if the two of them don't
know each other. What does Sakura want to do with
Yoriko-san?

dialogues.jp:
二人の接点が見えないという部分が、妙に気に
掛かる。さくらが頼子さんに何の用がある？

dialogues.en: "This is like a secret mission."
dialogues.text: "This is like a secret mission."

dialogues.jp: 「こりゃ、｛おんみつ／隠密｝行動だな」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……今月の２９日って決めてあるんだ。日付
　をまたいだその時にって」
dialogues.en:
"......I decided to do it on the 29th of this month. When
the clock hits midnight......"
dialogues.text:
"......I decided to do it on the 29th of this month. When
the clock hits midnight......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あんまりずるずる伸ばしても、しょうがない
　と思ったんだ」
dialogues.en: "I thought I shouldn't let it extend too long."
dialogues.text: "I thought I shouldn't let it extend too long."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「たとえ愛する人がいたとしてもね、主君のた
　めに命をかけるのがサムライなんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Even if I have someone I love, I like to be a girl with a
chivalrous spirit."
dialogues.text:
"Even if I have someone I love, I like to be a girl with a
chivalrous spirit."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
（……何の話だ？　頼子さんを時代劇ファンに
　でもしようってのか？）
dialogues.en:
(......What are they talking about? Are they talking about
going to watch a chivalrous movie?)
dialogues.text:
(......What are they talking about? Are they talking about
going to watch a chivalrous movie?)

dialogues.jp:
ベンチの背後の茂みに隠れているのだが、いま
いち話が見えてこない。
dialogues.en:
I'm hiding in the bush behind the bench but still can't hear
what they're talking about.
dialogues.text:
I'm hiding in the bush behind the bench but still can't hear
what they're talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だから、残りの日々を有意義に使ってよね」
dialogues.en: "So please make meaningful use of the rest of your days."
dialogues.text: "So please make meaningful use of the rest of your days."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねっ！　お兄ちゃんっ」
dialogues.en: "You got it, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "You got it, oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……気づいてやがったか、コノヤロウ」
dialogues.en: "......You knew I was here!"
dialogues.text: "......You knew I was here!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクはね、お兄ちゃんなら匂いで分かるんだ
　から♪」
dialogues.en: "I can find you by your scent, you know."
dialogues.text: "I can find you by your scent, you know."

dialogues.jp: 人差し指で、鼻の先をちょこんと指す。
dialogues.en: She points her forefinger at her nose.
dialogues.text: She points her forefinger at her nose.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんも、同じだよねえ？」
dialogues.en: "You can do the same for me, can't you?"
dialogues.text: "You can do the same for me, can't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「分かるかっ」
dialogues.en: "No way!"
dialogues.text: "No way!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「何だったら、マーキングしたってＯＫだよ♪」
dialogues.en: "If necessary, you can leave a scent marking on me!"
dialogues.text: "If necessary, you can leave a scent marking on me!"

dialogues.jp: 突き出してくる唇に、｛うめ／呻｝きつつ呟く。
dialogues.en: She purses her lips for a kiss.
dialogues.text: She purses her lips for a kiss.

dialogues.jp:
「俺の能力が和菓子じゃなくてワサビだったら、
　お前のそれに塗ったくってやるところだ」
dialogues.en:
"If I could use my power to get wasabi instead of sweets
right now, I'd put that on your lips."
dialogues.text:
"If I could use my power to get wasabi instead of sweets
right now, I'd put that on your lips."

dialogues.jp: 「というか、お前は何しに来たんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, what are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, what are you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「デートの、お・邪・魔」
dialogues.en: "I came here to interrupt your date."
dialogues.text: "I came here to interrupt your date."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ジョークだよ、ジョーク。こんなところで、
　決闘ポイント増やしたくないもん」
dialogues.en: "I'm just kidding with you. I don't want to fight you here."
dialogues.text: "I'm just kidding with you. I don't want to fight you here."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺は望むところだがな」
dialogues.en: "I would rather like to."
dialogues.text: "I would rather like to."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うんっ。それでこそお兄ちゃんだよっ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, that's my oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Yes, that's my oniichan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「な、何だ？」
dialogues.en: "What is wrong with you?"
dialogues.text: "What is wrong with you?"

dialogues.jp: 変にニコニコしちゃって。気味の悪い奴。
dialogues.en: She's smiling all of a sudden. She's such a creepy girl.
dialogues.text: She's smiling all of a sudden. She's such a creepy girl.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「デートの邪魔もいいんだけど、今は頼子さん
　とお話をしに来たの。ね？」
dialogues.en:
"Interrupting your date sounds nice to me too, but I came
here to talk to Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text:
"Interrupting your date sounds nice to me too, but I came
here to talk to Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp:
いくないことを織り交ぜつつ、頼子さんに話を
振った。頼子さんは、ええと頷く。
dialogues.en: She turns around to Yoriko-san, who just nods back at her.
dialogues.text: She turns around to Yoriko-san, who just nods back at her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そして、お話はもう終わり。だから……」
dialogues.en: "And I am finished talking with her. So......"
dialogues.text: "And I am finished talking with her. So......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「Ｇｏｏｄ　ｎｉｇｈｔ！」
dialogues.en: "Good night!"
dialogues.text: "Good night!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……何なんだ、あいつは……」
dialogues.en: "......What was that all about......?"
dialogues.text: "......What was that all about......?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……あ、転んだ。ったくかったるい奴め……」
dialogues.en:
"......Oh, she tripped over?! Oh man, she's such a pain in
the neck......"
dialogues.text:
"......Oh, she tripped over?! Oh man, she's such a pain in
the neck......"

dialogues.jp:
手を貸しに行ってやろうと思ったが、それより
早く、さくらは走り去っていった。
dialogues.en:
I'm about to run to her to help her up, but she gets up
quickly and runs away.
dialogues.text:
I'm about to run to her to help her up, but she gets up
quickly and runs away.

dialogues.jp: 「……変な奴」
dialogues.en: "......What a weirdo."
dialogues.text: "......What a weirdo."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「面白い人ですね……」
dialogues.en: "She's funny......"
dialogues.text: "She's funny......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……ま、メロンパンみたいな奴だな。たまに
　なら、面白いで済むんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"......She's like a melon-bread. It's fun to have every once
in a while."
dialogues.text:
"......She's like a melon-bread. It's fun to have every once
in a while."

dialogues.jp: 毎日だと、さすがに胸焼けする。
dialogues.en: But if I have to have it everyday, it gives me heartburn...
dialogues.text: But if I have to have it everyday, it gives me heartburn...

dialogues.jp: 「……でも、二人して何の話してたの？」
dialogues.en: "......Anyway, what were you two talking about? I heard..."
dialogues.text: "......Anyway, what were you two talking about? I heard..."

dialogues.jp: 「残りの日々を有意義にだとか、何だとか──」
dialogues.en:
"I heard something like making meaningful use of the rest of
your days......"
dialogues.text:
"I heard something like making meaningful use of the rest of
your days......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お願いがあるんです」
dialogues.en: "I have a favor to ask you."
dialogues.text: "I have a favor to ask you."

dialogues.jp:
俺が言い終わらないうちに、頼子さんの声がか
ぶった。珍しく固い声音だ。
dialogues.en:
Before I finish talking, she cuts me off. And her voice is
unusually firm.
dialogues.text:
Before I finish talking, she cuts me off. And her voice is
unusually firm.

dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「その……出来たら……いえ、是非、なんです
　けど……」
dialogues.en:
"If you can...... I mean, I would really like if you
can......"
dialogues.text:
"If you can...... I mean, I would really like if you
can......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「う、うん。何よ？」
dialogues.en: "Y-Yes, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "Y-Yes, what is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お給料、いただけますか？」
dialogues.en: "I would like to get paid."
dialogues.text: "I would like to get paid."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うえっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
幻の計算機が目の前に現れ、瞬時に、残りの小
遣いをはじき出す。
dialogues.en:
An imaginary calculator appears in front of my eyes, and I
start to calculate how much money I could give her.
dialogues.text:
An imaginary calculator appears in front of my eyes, and I
start to calculate how much money I could give her.

dialogues.jp: 「い、いくら？」
dialogues.en: "H-How much do you want?"
dialogues.text: "H-How much do you want?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お金じゃありません」
dialogues.en: "I don't want any money."
dialogues.text: "I don't want any money."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そ、その……私と……」
dialogues.en: "I...I want you to......"
dialogues.text: "I...I want you to......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「デート、してくれますか？」
dialogues.en: "I want you to go on a date with me."
dialogues.text: "I want you to go on a date with me."

dialogues.jp: ◆お給料◆
dialogues.en: ◆It's been about a week since we started her training.◆
dialogues.text: ◆It's been about a week since we started her training.◆

dialogues.jp:
あれから訓練を繰り返し、ついに頼子さんは一
人で桜公園まで行くことができた。
dialogues.en: (She's been doing well these days.)
dialogues.text: (She's been doing well these days.)

dialogues.jp:
その上、ベンチに一定時間一人で座って居ると
いう訓練も、自らやりたいと申し出てくる。
dialogues.en:
She used to look very weak and hunch her back when she
walked, but tonight she's different.
dialogues.text:
She used to look very weak and hunch her back when she
walked, but tonight she's different.

dialogues.jp:
その訓練の途中、ベンチに一人座った頼子さん
に話し掛ける人影が……それは、さくらだった。
dialogues.en:
She's walking with her back straight. Her head's looking
straight forward, moving both of her arms rhythmically. And
she doesn't turn around to check whether I'm walking behind
her.
dialogues.text:
She's walking with her back straight. Her head's looking
straight forward, moving both of her arms rhythmically. And
she doesn't turn around to check whether I'm walking behind
her.

dialogues.jp:
忍んで行って二人の話を聴いてみようと試みた
が、さくらにはあっさりと見つかってしまった。
dialogues.en: (Good!)
dialogues.text: (Good!)

dialogues.jp:
そんな訓練が終わった後、突然頼子さんは、給
料としてデートをして欲しいと、俺に告げるの
だった。
dialogues.en:
I can see confidence in her back. She's walking with light
steps.
dialogues.text:
I can see confidence in her back. She's walking with light
steps.
